15 Public interest: review in other cases.

(1) This section applies where this Part applies by virtue of section 1(2).

(2) This section applies at all times—
(a) after a court makes an order under section 3(6), [F427A(8) or 8(5)] , and
(b) before the accused is acquitted or convicted or the prosecutor decides not to
proceed with the case concerned.
